info.name: Perfume Store - Complete API Walkthrough
info.description: Run all folders in their numbered order with ONE iteration. Configure baseUrl, adminEmail and adminPassword first. The default admin belongs to perfume-store-seed.sql; that seed is optional if another admin exists. This collection creates fresh demo accounts, categories, products, an order and reviews on the running database. It uses captured IDs rather than assuming IDs start at 1. It never sends the MySQL password and never resets existing accounts. Expected 400/401/403/404/409 responses are passing negative tests. An unexpected HTTP status stops the remaining collection workflow. Run from the first request again to start a fresh demonstration. All URLs point to baseUrl; there are no external API calls. Surviving demo records intentionally preserve order history and soft-delete relationships. This collection cannot itself read terminal AOP logs or prove simultaneous checkout behavior; those checks belong to StoreIntegrationTests and terminal observation.

variable.description: Running application URL; omit the trailing slash.
Existing administrator email. Default belongs to the optional demo seed.
Demo password only. Set a local value if your administrator differs.
Password assigned to the two demo customers created by each run.

item.name: 00 - Initialize and administrator login
item.description: Run the entire collection in order. This folder creates a fresh run tag and verifies administrator credentials before any mutations.

item.name: 01 - Initialize run and read public catalog

request.description: Always start here. Resets generated IDs and uses unique customer/category/product names for this run. Does not erase existing application records.
Default credentials are for the optional SQL seed. Replace adminEmail/adminPassword collection variables if you use a different administrator.

exec: pm.test("Account has ADMIN role", function () { pm.expect(data.role).to.eql("ADMIN"); });

item.name: 01 - Accounts and authentication
item.description: Creates two fresh customers. HTTP Basic verifies real database credentials; no JWT or session login endpoint is used.

exec: pm.test("Registration creates CUSTOMER without a hash", function () { pm.expect(data.role).to.eql("CUSTOMER"); pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property("passwordHash"); });
pm.test("Authenticated ID matches Alice", function () { pm.expect(String(data.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("psCustomerId")); pm.expect(data.role).to.eql("CUSTOMER"); });
pm.test("Validation response includes field errors", function () { pm.expect(data.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(data.fieldErrors).to.have.property("email"); });

item.name: 02 - Administrator categories
item.description: Creates two assigned categories and a third unused category for deletion. Existing categories are untouched.

exec: pm.test("Updated description is returned", function () { pm.expect(data.description).to.eql("Updated category description."); });

item.name: 03 - Products, filters and pagination
item.description: Creates three fictional products, one sold out. Every product ID is captured from the creation response.

exec: pm.test("Many-to-many assignment is returned", function () { pm.expect(data.categories).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(data.stockQuantity).to.eql(10); });

pm.test("Both category IDs are present", function () { pm.expect(data.categories.map(c => String(c.id))).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("psCategoryOneId")); pm.expect(data.categories.map(c => String(c.id))).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("psCategoryTwoId")); });
pm.test("Search finds the three demo products", function () { pm.expect(data.totalElements).to.eql(3); });
pm.test("Category contains exactly the three demo products", function () { pm.expect(data.totalElements).to.eql(3); });
pm.test("Price filter returns the first product", function () { pm.expect(data.totalElements).to.eql(1); pm.expect(String(data.content[0].id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("psProductId")); });
pm.test("Two products have stock", function () { pm.expect(data.totalElements).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Only the sold-out product is returned", function () { pm.expect(data.totalElements).to.eql(1); pm.expect(String(data.content[0].id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("psSoldOutId")); });

item.name: 28 - Sort by price with a one-item page

request.description: 28 - Sort by price with a one-item page

exec: pm.test("Sorting and page metadata are correct", function () { pm.expect(data.content).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(data.totalPages).to.eql(3); pm.expect(String(data.content[0].id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("psProductId")); });
pm.test("Missing item response is clear", function () { pm.expect(data.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(data.message).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(data.path).to.include("/api/products/"); });

item.name: 05 - Cart and cart privacy
item.description: Uses the two newly registered customers, whose carts start empty. Adding to a cart does not reserve or deduct stock.

exec: pm.test("Empty cart total is zero", function () { pm.expect(data.items).to.have.lengthOf(0); pm.expect(data.totalAmount).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("Cart total uses quantity two", function () { pm.expect(data.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(data.items[0].quantity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(data.totalAmount).to.eql(100.5); });

item.name: 08 - Reviews and authorship
item.description: Reviews use the authenticated customer identity. The implementation permits one review per customer per active product; a prior purchase is not required by the assignment.

exec: pm.test("Review is tied to Alice and this product", function () { pm.expect(String(data.authorId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("psCustomerId")); pm.expect(String(data.productId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("psProductId")); pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property("authorEmail"); });

pm.test("Both reviews are counted with one per page", function () { pm.expect(data.content).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(data.totalElements).to.eql(2); pm.expect(data.totalPages).to.eql(2); });

item.description: Soft-deletes only the first product created by this run. Historical orders, reviews and assigned category records remain intentionally.

item.name: 84 - Public in-stock category results exclude the removed product

exec: pm.test("Only the second available product remains", function () { pm.expect(data.totalElements).to.eql(1); pm.expect(String(data.content[0].id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("psSecondProductId")); });

pm.test("Inactive product remains in admin results", function () { pm.expect(data.totalElements).to.eql(3); const product = data.content.find(p => String(p.id) === pm.collectionVariables.get("psProductId")); pm.expect(product).not.to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(product.active).to.eql(false); });
